name: testimonial-list
title: Testimonial list
description: Customer quotes set as editorial rows between hairlines: the words large on the left, the person and their result on the right.
docs: Pass title, an optional eyebrow, and testimonials ({ id, quote, name, role, company, avatar?, result? }). The list adds the quotation marks. A row is the quote on the left and the person on the right (portrait or initials, name, 'role, company'); result adds a chip that screen readers hear as 'Result: …', and labels.result translates that word. Hairlines divide the rows, on a phone each row is the quote and then the person, and nothing animates.
